type.label: Weakness of the intrinsic hand muscles

phenotypicFeatures.description: weakness of the abduction and adduction of the fingers bilaterally (4/5 in the MRC scale)
weakness in the plantar (4/5) and dorsal (3/5), flexion and inversion (4/5), and eversion (4/5) of the feet bilaterally
Tendon reflexes were absent in all four extremities
plantar responses were not elicited bilaterally

type.label: Distal sensory impairment of all modalities

phenotypicFeatures.description: hypoalgesia and reduced temperature sensation in a stocking-glove distribution
mild deficits in joint position sense peripherally in all four extremities
Pallesthesia was abolished in both feet and severely reduced in both hands
could not walk on heels or on toes
absence of compound muscle action potentials (CMAP's) on the peroneal and tibial nerve
increased distal latency... and decreased motor conduction velocity

type.label: Decreased amplitude of sensory action potentials

phenotypicFeatures.description: no sensory nerve action potentials recorded in the sural, median, and ulnar nerve
spontaneous activity and neuropathic recruitment pattern in the anterior tibial muscles bilaterally
increase in the size of the median and ulnar nerves
increased protein and no nucleated cells
parkinsonism, gait unsteadiness, and frequent falls
